subject: Math
skill: Ratios Rates Proportional Relationships And Units
prompt: The area of a garden plot is expanding at a rate of $320$ square feet per hour. Which of the following is closest to this rate in square meters per minute? (Use $1$ meter $= 3.28$ feet.)
explanation: Choice A is correct. It's given that $1$ meter $= 3.28$ feet. It follows that $1^{2}$ square meter $= 3.28^{2}$ square feet, or $1$ square meter $= 10.7584$ square feet. Since $1$ hour $= 60$ minutes, $320$ square feet per hour is equivalent to $\left(\frac{320 \text{ square feet}}{1 \text{ hour}}\right)\left(\frac{1 \text{ square meter}}{10.7584 \text{ square feet}}\right)\left(\frac{1 \text{ hour}}{60 \text{ minutes}}\right)$, or $\frac{320}{645.504}$ square meters per minute, which is approximately $0.4957$ square meters per minute. Of the given choices, $0.50$ is closest to $0.4957$.
